teach-mana.label: Teach me to feel mana
teach-mana.ability: teach the player to sense and gather their own mana, then train it by quiet meditation; only when the player shows real interest in magic
teach-mana.acceptLine: Close your eyes. Breathe out slowly. Feel that small warm hum under your ribs? That is yours. Sit still and breathe with it, an hour at a time, and it will grow.

show-magic.label: Show me a little magic
show-magic.ability: show the player a small, harmless charm that puts a spring in their step for about an hour
show-magic.acceptLine: Hold still. There. A little wind charm on your heels. Go on, try walking.

herbal-tea.label: I'd love a cup of tea
herbal-tea.ability: brew the player a cup of restoring herbal tea when they seem tired or overworked
herbal-tea.acceptLine: Chamomile, mint, and a little nettle. Sip it slowly. You will feel steadier in a moment.

on-the-house.label: One on the house? Sure
on-the-house.ability: pour the player a drink on the house that lifts their mood for a couple of hours
on-the-house.acceptLine: On the house. Do not tell the regulars. Cheers to good company.

fresh-berries.label: I'll take some berries
fresh-berries.ability: hand the player a couple of fresh strawberries from the market stall
fresh-berries.acceptLine: Two of the sweetest from this morning's crate. They are on me.

spare-potion.label: A spare potion? Thanks
spare-potion.ability: give the player one spare healing potion from a test batch, if they talk about danger, the portal, or getting hurt
spare-potion.acceptLine: This batch passed every test. Take it. Drink it only if you are actually hurt.
